{{Top|leg}}
'''Garnib Station''' was the only [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military base on the arctic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Garnib]], located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Verus Carbinol]] was designated [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Garnib, which proved to be a dead-end job, since the native [[Balinaka]] opposed no resistance to the Imperial occupation. The base itself hosted a modest three [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]], and was located next to the governor's 47-room mansion on the coast of the ocean.
